text: {"lessons":["My account is still above its Period 1 value despite the recent decline, so I should assess results over a longer horizon rather than react to a few down months.","Selling Stock A at a large gain did not prevent the portfolio from later falling; one trade cannot establish a reliable strategy when prices are unpredictable.","Losses bother me more than gains please me, so I should avoid panic-selling or trading just to ease discomfort; I can hold when I have no clear reason to act."]}
